SELECT v.id, v.name, v.address, ST_Y(v.location::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(v.location::geometry) AS longitude, CONCAT(tbl_u.distrito, ', ', tbl_u.provincia, ', ', tbl_u.departamento) AS ubigeo, v.is_illuminated AS illuminated, v.id_sports AS sports, v.id_surfaces AS surfaces, COALESCE(r.avg_points, 0) AS avgRating, COALESCE(r.review_count, 0) AS reviewCount, p.url AS photoUrl, v.max_capacity AS maxCapacity, v.base_price AS basePrice, (SELECT MIN(precio_hora_extra) FROM available_venues av WHERE av.venue_id = v.id AND av.status = 1) AS extraHourPrice, (SELECT MIN(price) FROM available_venues av WHERE av.venue_id = v.id AND av.status = 1) AS minPrice FROM venues v LEFT JOIN ubigeo_peru tbl_u ON v.ubigeo = tbl_u.inei LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT AVG(vr.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(vr.id) AS review_count FROM venue_reviews vr WHERE vr.venue_id = v.id ) r ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT vp.id::text AS url FROM venue_photos vp WHERE vp.venue_id = v.id ORDER BY vp.created_at ASC LIMIT 1 ) p ON true WHERE v.status = 1
AND #{sportId} = ANY(v.id_sports)
AND v.id_surfaces && ARRAY[
#{sid}
]::integer[]
AND v.is_illuminated = #{isIlluminated}
AND (v.name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.address ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND ST_DWithin( v.location, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326)::geography, #{radiusMeters} )
ORDER BY
ST_Distance( v.location, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{lng}, #{lat}), 4326)::geography ) ASC
v.created_at DESC

SELECT v.id, v.name, v.address, ST_Y(v.location::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(v.location::geometry) AS longitude, CONCAT(tbl_u.distrito, ', ', tbl_u.provincia, ', ', tbl_u.departamento) AS ubigeo, v.dimensions AS dimensions, v.is_illuminated AS illuminated, v.id_sports AS sports, v.id_surfaces AS surfaces, COALESCE(r.avg_points, 0) AS avgRating, COALESCE(r.review_count, 0) AS reviewCount, p.url AS photoUrl, v.max_capacity AS maxCapacity, v.base_price AS basePrice, (SELECT MIN(precio_hora_extra) FROM available_venues av WHERE av.venue_id = v.id AND av.status = 1) AS extraHourPrice, (SELECT MIN(price) FROM available_venues av WHERE av.venue_id = v.id AND av.status = 1) AS minPrice FROM venues v LEFT JOIN ubigeo_peru tbl_u ON v.ubigeo = tbl_u.inei LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT AVG(vr.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(vr.id) AS review_count FROM venue_reviews vr WHERE vr.venue_id = v.id ) r ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT vp.id::text AS url FROM venue_photos vp WHERE vp.venue_id = v.id ORDER BY vp.created_at ASC LIMIT 1 ) p ON true WHERE v.host_user_id = #{hostUserId} ORDER BY v.created_at DESC
